question: How does consciousness relate to the seat containing all paths?
premises: From that very enclosure arises the seat containing all paths
Consciousness attains the state of being supported in that abode
Consciousness again attains the state of being the support
inference: Consciousness alternately appears as supported and as support within the seat of all paths.
plain_english: From that very principle, in the abode of the seat that contains all the paths, consciousness attains the state of being supported and again becomes the support.
